name: laa-mods
description: Mods for the laa toolkit: blocks file changes and commits on the default branch, shows laa status above the prompt, a pane to triage open learnings, and a /laa:retro nudge when a pipeline ends.

guard.title: Default-branch guard
guard.description: Where to block edits and commits on the default branch: repos adopted by laa (.claude/laa/ exists), every git repo, or nowhere.
